title: CircleFlow: Gas Flow in the Anesthesia Machine and Breathing Circuit
description:
A free, in-browser educational simulator that shows gas flow in the anesthesia machine and breathing circuit as moving particles. It covers bellows (ascending), piston, blower (turbine) and volume reflector ventilators in 17 scenarios, with Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) versions.

Simulator: https://anesthesia-sims.github.io/circleflow/ (English: /en/, Simplified Chinese: /zh/, Traditional Chinese: /zh-tw/)
